Class PERTCPMGraph

java.lang.Object
org.example.sprint3.PERTCPMGraph
public class PERTCPMGraph extends Object
Class representing a PERT/CPM (Program Evaluation Review Technique / Critical Path Method) graph. This graph is used to model and analyze project activities, durations, dependencies, and critical paths. The graph is built as a directed graph where vertices represent activities and edges represent dependencies.

  • Method Details

    • buildGraph

      public void buildGraph(List<Activity> activities)
      Builds the project graph by adding activities as vertices and creating edges for their dependencies. Automatically includes "START" and "END" vertices to represent the start and end of the project.
      Parameters:
      activities - A list of activities to be included in the project graph.

    • validateNoCircularDependencies

      public void validateNoCircularDependencies()
      Validates the graph for circular dependencies using a depth-first search (DFS). Throws an exception if a circular dependency is detected.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if a circular dependency is found.

    • topologicalSort

      public List<Activity> topologicalSort()
      Performs a topological sort of the project graph to determine an order of execution for activities.
      Returns:
      A list of activities in topological order.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the graph contains a cycle.

    • getTopologicalSortAsString

      public String getTopologicalSortAsString()
      Returns the topological sort result as a formatted string of activity IDs.
      Returns:
      A string representing the topological order (e.g., "1 -> 2 -> 3").
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the graph contains a cycle.

    • calculateEarliestAndLatestTimes

      public void calculateEarliestAndLatestTimes()
      Calculates the earliest start (ES), earliest finish (EF), latest start (LS), and latest finish (LF) times for all activities in the graph using forward and backward passes.

    • printActivityTimes

      public void printActivityTimes()
      Prints a formatted table of activity times, including: Earliest Start (ES), Earliest Finish (EF), Latest Start (LS), Latest Finish (LF), and Slack. Activities with IDs "START" and "END" are excluded from the output.

    • getGraph

      public Graph<Activity,Integer> getGraph()
      Retrieves the internal graph representation of activities and dependencies.
      Returns:
      The graph object representing the PERT/CPM network.

    • exportScheduleToCsv

      public void exportScheduleToCsv(String filePath)
      Exports the activity schedule to a CSV file with detailed information for each activity. The CSV format includes columns for activity ID, cost, duration, time metrics (ES, EF, LS, LF), slack, and dependencies.
      Parameters:
      filePath - The file path where the CSV will be saved.

    • identifyCriticalPath

      public List<Activity> identifyCriticalPath()
      Identifies and returns the critical path activities in the graph. The critical path is composed of activities with zero slack.
      Returns:
      A list of activities on the critical path.

    • identifyBottleneckActivities

      public List<Activity> identifyBottleneckActivities()
      Identifies bottleneck activities in the graph. Bottleneck activities are those with the highest number of dependencies.
      Returns:
      A list of bottleneck activities.
